titulo: Me saying I'm five minutes away
caption:
Me saying I'm five minutes away

Me saying "5 min away" for forty minutes.

The friend who waits is doing math the whole time. Say the real time, even if it is worse.

Send it to the friend who is always five minutes away.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right, with a small digital clock on the wall above the amber one reading 7:00. The amber one takes three small steps in three rounds, each time with a little pulse, and each time the clock jumps ahead, 7:15, 7:30, 7:40, while the blue one waits with narrowed eyes, then looks down and tilts, then closes its eyes. When the amber one finally arrives, the blue one narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me saying 5 min away for forty minutes.
